script.textEN: Our village is in a valley, between two hills.
script.textCN: 我们的村庄坐落在山谷中，位于两座小山之间。

script.textEN: He is swimming across the river.
The school building is beside a park.
Some children are coming out of the building.
script.textCN: 一些孩子正从大楼里出来。

script.textEN: Some of them are going into the park.
script.textCN: 他们中的一些人正走进公园。
